activation_after: MRCS-05 + MAL-01..10 completed_verified + core owner contracts; later MRCS domains late-bind; GPR-16 requires MRCS-21 and relevant specialist golden proofs

execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a surviving GPR tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries it through implementation, required validation, verified closeout and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated roadmap, benchmark and source archaeology.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, durable-evidence verification, reconciliation and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: If a surviving tranche cannot credibly preserve the closeout reserve, split it before governed start rather than overrunning the execution contract.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; classify the failure and require changed evidence before retry.

required_upstream: core Action/Event, Character, World/Scene, Combat and Inventory/Asset owner contracts available
boundaries: GPR is the reusable gameplay-pattern execution and loop-composition layer; it does not become a second Character, World, Scene, Combat, Inventory, Economy, Project, Action/Event or content-definition ledger
MAL-01..10 remain completed_verified and frozen; GPR consumes MAL contracts and extends broad pattern coverage without rebuilding or rewriting MAL completion evidence
MRCS and canonical definition owners retain rule/content-definition authority; GPR binds accepted definitions into executable instances rather than becoming a second Content Forge
Action/Event and canonical domain owners retain mutation truth; GPR composes operations and emits typed outcomes/Events but may not create parallel owner state

GPR-05 is the common owner-domain operation adapter seam for movement/combat/projectile/ability/resource/interaction/inventory/economy/progression/objective/route execution and must not implement duplicate owner engines
GPR-06 and GPR-07 remain separate bounded implementation seams despite shared infrastructure because their adapter payloads are materially different
PDCP Packet 07 owns generic proposal/preview/dry-run/commit/explanation/intervention/compensation/debug/recovery semantics; GPR-08/09/12 implement GPR-specific surfaces only
PCA-12 and PDCP Packet 08 own generic simulation/formal-analysis machinery; GPR supplies runtime models, conformance fixtures and interpretation only
ARI/PCA retain generic resource identity, rights, derivative provenance, version/review/import-export; GPR-10 supplies runtime semantic-role binding and production-use validation only
MCS/MCCS/MNCS/MSAS retain map, presentation/actor, NPC/creature and audio authoring authority; GPR binds accepted outputs without absorbing creator domains
the seven supported delivery modes are direct play, cozy/low-pressure play, GM-led play, world-map/TTRPG bridge, embedded minigame, user-authored loop mini and Multiversal roster injection
delivery-mode adaptation may change governed policy/configuration but cannot create a second mechanics truth
GPR-12 owns gameplay-instance multiplayer/replay/snapshot/migration/recovery/version continuity while owner-domain idempotency/version/recovery semantics remain authoritative for owner mutations
GPR-15 no longer exists as a standalone tranche; its 168-pattern/85-operation/672-variant conformance requirement is mandatory inside GPR-16
reduced MERA/MBES/MSLR/MSWI consume GPR execution/composition but retain their own domain truth; GPR does not absorb downstream specialist semantics
runtime code consumes semantic operation, primitive, pattern and asset-role IDs; source-game names, ROM offsets and protected expression are not runtime rule identities
source-ROM assets, commercial screenshots/maps/sprites/music and other protected reference expression remain evidence only and cannot become a production dependency
unknown owner data remains unknown rather than zero/empty/unlimited/compatible; unsupported operations fail closed rather than falling back to invented semantics
visibility/permission filtering occurs before participant/target lists, counts, diagnostics, replay/export, AI context and presentation-role binding
no 3D renderer, twitch-only input path or paid/cloud provider is required for blocking GPR execution, authoring, replay, recovery or proof
optional AI is visibility-safe advisory only and cannot grant permission, mutate owner state, canonize definitions or declare proof passed
no GPR implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a specific surviving GPR work item
late_bind_upstream: MCS/MCCS/MNCS/MAS/MSAS outputs and other specialist creator outputs
